locations.note: Detective Nick Kang drives, shoots and fights across a 240-square-mile recreation of Los Angeles, from Chinatown bombings to the Russian mob, the Triads and the truth about his father's death.
The case opens with bombings in Chinatown, the Triads' ground.
Downtown's streets and towers are the hub of the open city.
Hollywood and the Hollywood Hills, with missions among the studios and the hillside houses.
Beverly Hills, the mansions and Rodeo Drive, part of the drivable city.
Santa Monica, from the pier to the airport, where missions end on the runway.
The marina and its harbour, the south-western edge of the map.
